entities.summary: Guity Novin is an Iranian-born Canadian artist, known as a figurative painter and graphic designer. She classifies her work as "transpressionism", a term coined by Novin in the 1990s. Her works are in private and public collections worldwide. Novin has served on a UNESCO national committee of artists.
